component.name: Skies of Arcadia Legends: Recompiled
component.summary: A native port of the GameCube game, played from your own disc

developer.name: The Skies of Arcadia Legends: Recompiled contributors

description.p: A static recompilation of Skies of Arcadia Legends for the GameCube, running natively with no emulator. It doesn't include the game: it imports and patches your own disc image (USA, Europe or Japan).

ul.li: Widescreen and any window shape, high resolutions and anti-aliasing
60 fps or the display's refresh rate through frame interpolation
Save states, faster battles and field, optional cheats
HD texture packs and the Dreamcast music
